message.content:
Fix the highest-impact reliability/UX gap in the Nxeon platform: a failed VPS/game-server provision strands the paying customer on a dead screen. Plus a few smaller error-surfacing fixes. Work EXCLUSIVELY in /opt/nxeon-wt-provfail (branch feature/gap-provfail). node_modules symlinked. Do NOT run build/prisma commands — code only. Do NOT touch billing/order/renewal money files (another agent is editing those).

PRIMARY FIX — VPS/game provision-failure state + notification:
- A terminal PROVISION failure sets `Server.status = "ERROR"` (worker/index.ts ~1230, crash-recovery ~1281). But `app/dashboard/servers/[id]/page.tsx` renders banners only for SUSPENDED (~810) and the transitional set PENDING/PROVISIONING/REINSTALLING/DELETING (~817) — there is NO branch for ERROR. So an ERROR server shows a red status dot, no message, no retry, no support link, and still renders the normal start/stop ServerControls that can't help.
- ADD an ERROR-status branch on the server detail page: a clear red banner ("Provisioning failed — {error if available}. We've been notified. Retry, or contact support."), a **Retry provision** action, and a **Contact support** link; and hide/replace the useless start/stop controls for an ERROR server. Study how hosting (components/customer/HostingClient.tsx:176 "Setup failed" + retry), email (EmailHosting.tsx:330 + retry ~363), and sites (SitesManager.tsx:174 + retry) already do this and mirror the pattern for servers. If a `retryProvision` server action doesn't exist, add one (re-enqueue a PROVISION job for an ERROR-status server the caller owns; reuse the existing job/worker machinery; guard ownership + status===ERROR). Surface any Server.error/lastError field if present; if the schema has no per-server error text, add a nullable `Server.provisionError String?` and set it on the failure path.
- NOTIFY the customer on provision failure: in the worker PROVISION failure path (worker/index.ts, near where status flips to ERROR / reconcileFailedJob ~1129), send the customer a notification (in-app db.notification + email via the existing mailer) — reuse the existing notification/mailer helpers (grep lib/ for notify/notification/mailer). Today provision failure sends NOTHING.

SECONDARY FIXES (small, real):
- components/customer/DomainControls.tsx:29 — the auto-renew toggle does `start(() => toggleDomainAutoRenew(domainId))` and DISCARDS the result, so a returned {error} is never shown (silent no-op on failure). Capture + surface the error inline (match the file's other error handling).
- components/customer/HostingClient.tsx:50 — `await retryHostingProvision(id)` with no result check; surface a returned error (the order path at ~:37 in the same file already does).
- components/customer/NxcloudClient.tsx:259 — a hard failure shows `inst.error` in AMBER; make a failed instance RED and add a Retry action (mirror the hosting retry).
- (Optional, cosmetic) unify the plain-text empty states in SslCertificates.tsx / Volumes.tsx / EmailHosting.tsx onto the richer shared `EmptyState` component used by servers/domains/etc.

Keep changes surgical and match existing patterns. DELIVER, then commit `git add -A && git commit -m "fix(ux): VPS/game provision-failure ERROR state + retry + customer notify; surface swallowed toggle/retry errors; NxCloud retry"` (trailer Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>), `git push -u origin feature/gap-provfail`. REPORT (factual): files changed, the ERROR-state UI + retry action + notification wiring, any schema field added, and each secondary fix. Don't claim tested.

Done. Committed and pushed to `feature/gap-provfail`.

## What I did

**PRIMARY — VPS/game provision-failure ERROR state + notification**

- **Schema** (`prisma/schema.prisma`): added nullable `Server.provisionError String?` (no per-server error text existed) to hold a human-readable failure reason, cleared on retry. *(Migration/`prisma generate` NOT run per instructions — that's a follow-up for the deploy owner.)*
- **Server detail page** (`app/dashboard/servers/[id]/page.tsx`): added an ERROR-status branch rendering the new `ProvisionErrorBanner`, and excluded `ERROR` from the start/stop `ServerControls` condition (previously ERROR fell through and rendered useless controls).
- **New component** (`components/customer/ProvisionErrorBanner.tsx`): red banner "Provisioning failed: {reason}. Our team has been notified…", a **Retry provision** button (with inline error surfacing), and a **Contact support** link (`/dashboard/support`) — mirrors the HostingClient/EmailHosting/Sites "Setup failed + retry" pattern.
- **Retry action** (`lib/actions-server-lifecycle.ts`): new `retryProvision(serverId)` — ownership-guarded, `status === "ERROR"` only, one-in-flight guard; atomically flips the row to `PROVISIONING` (clears `provisionError`) and re-enqueues a `PROVISION` job, reusing existing job/worker machinery (the provision handler keeps any persisted vmid, so no second VM leaks). Audit-logged.
- **Worker notification** (`worker/index.ts`): new `notifyProvisionFailed()` helper wired into both the runJob terminal-failure path AND the crash-recovery `reapStuckJobs` path. It persists a trimmed `provisionError`, sends an in-app `db.notification`, and emails via the existing `sendMail`/`emails` mailer. Also clears `provisionError` at the start of each provision run. Previously provision failure sent nothing.
- **Email template** (`lib/email-templates.ts`): added `provisionFailed` (danger accent), auto-available through `emails` in `lib/mailer.ts`.

**SECONDARY fixes**

- `components/customer/DomainControls.tsx`: the auto-renew toggle no longer discards its result — wrapped in a transition with try/catch, surfacing a returned `{error}` or thrown error inline (red text next to the switch).
- `components/customer/HostingClient.tsx`: `retry()` now checks the result and shows a returned error instead of reloading unconditionally.
- `components/customer/NxcloudClient.tsx` + `lib/actions-nxcloud.ts`: a FAILED instance now renders RED with a **Retry setup** action (was amber, no retry). Added `retryNxcloud()` action (owner/admin, FAILED-only, re-enqueues PROVISION on the backing server). Because nothing previously marked an nxcloud instance FAILED on a backing-VM provision failure, I also made `notifyProvisionFailed` mark the wrapper instance `FAILED` so the new UI is actually reachable.

**Skipped:** the optional/cosmetic `EmptyState` unification (SslCertificates/Volumes/EmailHosting) to keep the change surgical.

Not tested/built — no build or prisma commands were run per instructions. Note the `Server.provisionError` and nxcloud `FAILED`-state code depend on a Prisma migration + client regeneration before they'll compile/run.
